summary: Retest of the iteration 41 HIGH bugs. FIX 1 (Polygon USDC) PASSED: the RPC is now polygon-amoy-bor-rpc.publicnode.com (eth_chainId 0x13882). POST /wallet/evm/usdc/send with chain=polygon returns 400 'Invalid recipient' for a bogus address and 400 'Insufficient USDC on Polygon (PoS)' for a huge amount. 3 repeated calls all returned 400, never 502. /wallet/evm/chains lists polygon with usdc_balance 0.0 and the publicnode rpc_url. In the UI the send-error now shows a readable message instead of 'Request failed (502)'. FIX 2 (multisig balance check) PASSED: tested with a fresh TEST_ user (invite VAULTED-BETA) with multisig_enabled=true and an active cosigner cosigner-test@example.com, inserted directly in Mongo so no welcome email went out. ETH sends of 999999 and of 0.01 (the threshold) both returned 400 'Insufficient ETH'. No eth_approvals record was created, /approvals/pending stayed empty and the backend log shows no Resend email POST. Code review found no status_code=502 left in routers/wallet.py or routers/multichain_router.py; upstream RPC failures return 503. Send screen banner (390x844) now names the selected chain: ETH 'Ethereum Sepolia testnet', BTC 'Bitcoin Testnet3', SOL 'Solana Devnet', XLM 'Stellar Testnet', XRP 'XRPL Testnet', USDC 'Base/Arbitrum/Polygon testnet', and USDC Sepolia 'Ethereum testnet'. Regression test_iteration41_send_all_chains.py: 20/20 passed. No real on-chain sends were made. All TEST data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Still swallows RPC errors and reports usdc_balance/native_balance 0 with no error flag (multichain_router.py:51-56). If an RPC goes down, the user sees 0 instead of 'unavailable'. Consider adding a per-chain 'balance_error' field.

A generic exception from usdc_send_on_chain is mapped to 400 (multichain_router.py:106-107), so a transient RPC/network failure during broadcast shows as a user error instead of 503. The same 400 mapping applies to BTC/XLM/XRP submission failures (wallet.py:607,861,945). This is acceptable when the node rejects the tx, but network failures should return 503.

issues: USDC on Sepolia banner says 'Ethereum testnet' (it uses selectedEvmChain.short = 'Ethereum'). Consider 'Ethereum Sepolia testnet' to match the ETH chip.
PreviewBanner numberOfLines={2} truncates the chain-specific sentence on a 390px phone ('...use testn…'). The network name is still visible.
Still present from iteration 41: on a 390px phone the Feedback button covers the right edge of the network fee value ('~0.00001 XR').

action_items: (Low) Rename the USDC Sepolia banner text to 'Ethereum Sepolia testnet'.
(Low) Move or shrink the Feedback button so it does not cover the fee row on the Send screen on phones.
(Low) Map network/timeout exceptions in the USDC/BTC/XLM/XRP broadcast paths to 503 and keep 400 for node rejections; expose balance errors in /wallet/evm/chains.
critical_code_review_comments: eth_send pre-check (wallet.py:384-396) is correct: it checks value + gasPrice*21000 against the balance before the approval is inserted and the email sent, and returns 503 if Sepolia is unreachable.
There is a minor race: the balance can change between approval and the cosigner's decision. _broadcast_eth_send checks the balance again, so this is safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner text for 6 chips + 4 USDC chains, Polygon error message)

seed_data_creation: Created a temporary TEST_ms_<hex>@example.com user and a cosigner row (cosigner-test@example.com). Both were deleted via /auth/delete-account and by cosigner id. Verified 0 leftover users, cosigners or approvals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Polygon RPC is now publicnode. Multisig tests: register a TEST_ user, insert the cosigner directly in Mongo (adding via POST /cosigners needs Pro and sends an email), then PATCH /auth/security {multisig_enabled:true}. Never enable multisig on smoketest (its cosigner is a real email).
rca_of_issue: Both iteration 41 HIGH bugs are fixed: (1) the dead rpc-amoy.polygon.technology DNS was replaced with publicnode; (2) the multisig path now checks the balance before creating the approval.
